svg.title: From a source claim to a qualified implication
svg.desc: Dated source + exact section → what the source actually supports; Ranked exposure → opportunity to interact → possible monetized attention; Immediate impact: a creator has more opportunities to be seen; Conditional implication: sustained visibility could affect cultural diversity; Missing evidence: actual earnings, audience response and alternative explanations
svg.text: From a source claim to a qualified implication
Dated source + exact section → what the source actually supports
Ranked exposure → opportunity to interact → possible monetized attention
Immediate impact: a creator has more opportunities to be seen
Conditional implication: sustained visibility could affect cultural diversity
Missing evidence: actual earnings, audience response and alternative explanations
